items.source: Straightforward implementation of Cache.ValueWrapper, simply holding the value as given at construction and returning it from SimpleValueWrapper.get().
items.translation: `Cache.ValueWrapper` 的简单实现，在构造时直接保存给定值，并从 `SimpleValueWrapper.get()` 返回该值。

items.source: Wrap the given store value with a SimpleValueWrapper, also going through AbstractValueAdaptingCache.fromStoreValue(Object) conversion.
items.translation: 将给定的存储值用 `SimpleValueWrapper` 包装，同时经过 `AbstractValueAdaptingCache.fromStoreValue(Object)` 转换。
